data.body_html:
Imagine reeling in a feisty amberjack off Cabopino as the sun dips behind La Concha, then sipping cava while cruising back to Puerto Banús under a sherbet sky. That’s the fishing and sunset combo charter Marbella 2037 — two iconic Costa del Sol experiences wrapped into one seamless trip. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 4- to 8-hour charter pairs sportfishing with a sunset cruise, all included: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and fishing tackle on request. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or a first-timer, it’s the best way to spend a day on the water.

From the moment you step aboard, the crew handles everything. You’ll head to prime fishing grounds near Cala del Faro or the Río Verde estuary, where bream, sea bass, mackerel, and amberjack are common. After a few hours of casting, the boat turns west to catch the sunset over the Mediterranean. The Golden Mile glows, the mountains turn violet, and you toast the day with a glass of cava. This is Marbella at its finest.

Why Choose a Combo Charter?

Most boat trips are either fishing or sunset cruising — rarely both. This combo gives you the thrill of the catch and the romance of the sunset in one booking. You save time, money, and logistics. Plus, the timing works perfectly: fish during the late afternoon bite (16:00–19:00), then cruise into the golden hour (20:00–21:30 in summer). The skipper knows exactly where to position the boat for the best light.

It’s also flexible. Want to fish longer? Add hours. Prefer a shorter sunset cruise? Book a 4-hour slot. The boat is yours for the duration — no fixed schedule.

Our Fleet for the Combo

We offer a range of boats from Puerto Banús. For small groups (up to 8 pax), the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are excellent choices at €749/2h. For larger parties (up to 12 pax), the Mangusta 80 comes with a free jet ski and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. Other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Pershing 46 are available — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

What You Can Catch

The waters off Marbella are rich with species. Common catches include:

  • Bream (Dorada) — 1–3 kg, near rocky bottoms
  • Sea Bass (Lubina) — 2–5 kg, around river mouths
  • Mackerel (Caballa) — 0.5–1 kg, in schools
  • Amberjack (Medregal) — 5–15 kg, deeper waters
  • Red Snapper (Pargo) — 2–4 kg, near reefs

The skipper will adjust the location based on season and weather. Summer favours mackerel and bream; autumn brings amberjack. All tackle is provided — just bring your sunglasses and sunscreen.

Sunset Cruise Route

After fishing, the boat cruises west along the coast. You’ll pass:

  • Marbella Marina — luxury yachts and beach clubs
  • Golden Mile — hotels and mansions lit by the setting sun
  • La Concha Mountain — the iconic peak turns pink and orange
  • Puerto Banús — return to the port as lights flicker on

The skipper will anchor at a calm spot for photos and drinks. The sunset lasts about 30 minutes, but the afterglow lingers for another 20. Perfect for that Instagram shot.

What’s Included

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)
  • Fishing tackle on request

No hidden fees. You can bring your own food or order catering (ask us). The crew speaks English and Spanish.

How to Book

Ready to combine fishing and sunset? Contact us via WhatsApp or use the booking form on our site. Tell us your preferred date, group size, and boat. We’ll check availability and send a secure payment link. Advance booking is recommended — sunset slots are popular, especially in July and August.

For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats. Just ask.

It’s a half-day or full-day experience that starts with sportfishing off the Costa del Sol (targeting bream, sea bass, mackerel, or amberjack) and ends with a sunset cruise back to Puerto Banús. You get two experiences in one charter.

The sunset cruise typically runs from 20:00 to 21:30 in summer (May–September) and 18:00 to 19:30 in winter (October–April). Your skipper will adjust the itinerary so you catch the golden hour over the Mediterranean.
